citation: Gahreman DE, et al. J Exerc Nutrition Biochem 2016;20:1
protocol: 20-min interval sprint cycling (8-s sprints at 65% of maximum power, 12 s recovery) after green tea or cellulose capsules (placebo); HR and VO2 at rest, exercise and 15, 30, 45, 60 min after; lactate and glucose
population: 14 trained (VO2max 59.2 +/- 1.9) and 14 untrained (40.2 +/- 2.1 mL/kg/min) males, 23-25 y
note: Trained and untrained printed separately; mean +/- SEM; placebo condition columns; glucose at baseline.
